info.title: rp2350-gdb
info.description: Standalone GDB server and inspection CLI for the RP2350Sharp emulator. Loads a UF2/BIN firmware image, exposes Core 0 over the GDB Remote Serial Protocol, and dumps CPU and PIO state interactively.

options.name: --elf
options.description:
ELF with symbols (nanoCLR.elf). Enables the 'where' command and,
with --pe, a native-checksum preflight that warns when a deployed
assembly will be rejected by the CLR (CLR_E_ASSM_WRONG_CHECKSUM).

options.name: --channel
options.description: Serial output to echo: uart|usb|none (default: uart)

options.name: --run
options.description:
Start the CPU immediately (default: halted, so you can
set breakpoints before the first instruction runs)

options.name: --pe
options.description:
Build a deployment from compiled .pe assemblies and inject it
at 0x100FC000. Validates marker and CRCs, orders mscorlib
first, pads to 4 bytes. Repeatable; a directory takes
every .pe inside it.

options.name: --emit-deployment
options.description:
Also write the assembled deployment image to disk, e.g. to
feed bin2uf2 --merge for the real board.

options.name: --diagnose
options.description: Non-interactive: run n instructions, dump CPU + PIO, exit

options.name: --check-run
options.description:
Non-interactive: boot the firmware and report whether the
deployed app actually starts executing, or the CLR rejects
it and idles (e.g. CLR_E_TYPE_UNAVAILABLE). Needs --elf and
a deployment (--pe/--deploy).

options.name: --mcp
options.description:
Serve the running machine over MCP on 127.0.0.1:<port>
(default 3334) so an agent can diagnose it: CPU and memory
inspection with no side effects, memory snapshots and diffs
to catch corruption, instrumented step/step-over, raw RSP
packet injection, and a report of every moment the debugger
and the simulation loop contended for the machine.

options.name: --trace
options.description:
breakpoint the host hands GDB, plus CPU HardFault/RCP/lockup,
to diagnose "weird values"/corruption. Writes rp2350-gdb-trace.log
in the cwd (or the given .log path) and mirrors to stderr.
